ShortDescription.Value: A WriteEverywhere-Module that replaces Vanilla Signs with Dutch ones.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Dutch Vanilla Theme Overrider Hallo and Hello. This is a Vanilla Theme Overrider that turns Vanilla Signs, Roadmarkings and Decals to Dutch ones. This Overrider uses the ANWB Font. Can be found [here](https://www.maisfontes.com/anwb-uu-regular.font).
**Please use one Vanilla Overrider at one time!**
## Functions - Works **automaticly**, you don't need any knowledge whatsoever! - Variable working Street Signs - Bicycle Parking Spots - 3D Models for Signs
---
## Requirements - [Write Everywhere](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/92908/Windows) – required
---
## Check out the corrosponding Sign Pack or the other Country Packs/Overrider - [Dutch Signs](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/121223/Windows) - [Other Countries](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/authors/UnMaestro)
